summary: Frontend-only verification of framer-motion scroll animations + team ordering/naming on the Right Choice Services site. All 8 routes return 200, no console errors. Reveal component correctly sets initial opacity:0 & transform y=24 then animates to opacity:1 on viewport entry. Verified leadership order (Arjan, Tara, Robert) with photos, roster of 11 in required order, 'Florian Shabanaj' spelled correctly. Home 'How We Support' 4 cards animate (0->1). Services 'Key Services' 4 cards animate (0->1).
critical_code_review_comments: Reveal component is clean and reusable; using viewport once:true prevents re-trigger which is correct.
TeamPage LeaderCard uses paragraph.slice(0,40) as React key which is fragile if two paragraphs share the same first 40 chars; consider using index-based key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Animations verified via computed style checks (opacity/transform) on Reveal wrapper elements. Data-testids used: leadership-card (3), team-roster-card (11), home-how-card (4), services-key-card (4). All routes /, /about, /services, /team, /testimonials, /policies, /contact, /referrals returned 200 with no console errors.
